about: Open Graph share cards for artbitrage.io rooms: one 1200x630 JPEG per room, linked from each page's og:image and twitter:image. This file says what each card shows, where its record comes from, and how the cards are made.

how.design: THROUGH THE DOOR: you stand in the room (its wall colour); an arched door (the 閒 door's head) opens onto the next room, where the room's key work hangs whole, mounted as the room's own CSS mounts it. A room without a key work gets a typographic card: its glyph, or a line cited from the site, lettered on the far wall.
pipeline: VectorCraft measures every line of type (area type converted to point type gives the app's own line breaks; CJK breaks only after its punctuation).
VectorCraft composes three layers: ground (room, door, next room, far-wall lettering), mount (the room's frame or mat, or a backing under the work) and type.
PhotoCraft downscales the work once with Lanczos, never above 100%, keeping its aspect.
PhotoCraft grains the ground, places the mount with a drop shadow, places the work at 100% on whole pixels with no style, places the type and flattens.
The work's pixels in the flattened master are compared with the downscaled work; any difference fails the card.
PhotoCraft writes the JPEG, stepping quality down from 92 until the file is 200 KB or less.
how.reproducible: Same tool versions and macOS fonts give byte-identical cards (sha256 above).
